parent_body:
## Outcome
Expose saved branch history, main publications, pinned Commit/Layer comparisons, path revisions and attribution through the existing branch/file SDK families. Clients can compare unchanged text whose owning commits differ.

**Lane:** API (with Engine implementation sub-issues). **Status:** proposed work, not implemented. **Target branch:** `layerfs_v2_0_0` (not `layerfs_v_2_0_0`). **Inspected baseline:** `716197c4999fb087aa0fb17bac5ceb48b0b556ae`, verified locally and on GitHub on 2026-11-08.

## Owner design retained
- main is project core content; side branches are alternate work.
- Branch commits are checkpoints. No new checkpoint/revision family.
- Add `branch.commits`, `branch.get_commit`, `file.revision`. Retain `branch.get`, existing short verbs/nouns and the agreed get_commit exception.
- Public paging uses one-based `page` and `page_size`. Existing calls/options and commit.* remain compatible.
- Publication Layer, source Commit, parent and base relationships are distinct. Publication does not itself reassign blame ownership.

## API scope
**Branch:** update list/get/diff; add commits/get_commit; retain fork/merge/publish.
**File:** add revision; update diff/blame/read/stat/list/glob/grep; retain write/edit/cp/mv/mkdir/rm/apply.
`branch.diff(include_attribution:true)` discovers ownership-only paths even when content is equal. `file.diff(include_attribution:true)` returns aligned before/after owners with exact/coarse/unknown coverage. Keep independent content/metadata/identity/attribution facts and existing Added/Removed/Modified item kinds.

## Contract gate
The shared-contract child must settle matching-result pages versus sparse candidate-window pages, bounded deep-page access, immutable anchors, scope and compatibility before implementation. Candidate-window semantics are a proposal, not an owner-approved decision. Do not silently skip unreturned records, fabricate totals, or add a public cursor requirement. Preserve existing boolean has_more fields; any new tri-state response needs an explicit new contract. A bounded refusal is preferable to a false complete result.

## Delivery and acceptance
- [ ] Agree and document canonical references, pagination, scope, absent sides and coverage.
- [ ] Implement branch saved history/details, mixed-version tree comparison and attribution discovery.
- [ ] Implement path revisions, aligned file attribution and bounded pinned reads.
- [ ] Regenerate and verify JS/Python/CLI contracts and per-call documentation.
- [ ] Verify SQLite/PostgreSQL, native/worker reads where applicable, scope and legacy compatibility; retain failures/unrun results.

## Ownership and locations
Product SDK/engine and per-call docs land in layerfs. Connect integration is out of scope. Cross-layer qualification harnesses/receipts follow layerfs-benchmark policy. Use existing folders: api/crates/layerfs-api/src/{branch,file,calls}, control/crates/layerfs-store/src, engine/crates/layerfs-store-service/src/{history,read,methods}, and docs/architecture/api/sdk/{branch,file}. No Store format change, blanket index migration, merge/write redesign, human-author model or rename-following feature is authorized by this task.

The Connect renderer simulation is design evidence only, not proof that the native SDK supports these APIs. This issue tree contains the substantive specifications; no uncommitted local link is required to use it.

## References
- [Inspected LayerFS source](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/tree/716197c4999fb087aa0fb17bac5ceb48b0b556ae)
- Related existing interface work: Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs-project#30 (this tree scopes the branch/file extension specifically).
